description: Run one sysml prompt command (a % line) in a session and return what it printed. Prefer the typed tools, which return the same data structured: session_load/session_submit/session_eval/session_print/session_save/session_clear, session_run, debug_*, send, advance, features, instances, check/explain/solve/configure/optimize, sweep, runs, render_run. This tool reaches everything else the prompt can do — %instantiate, %invoke, %constraint, %requirement, %satisfy, %validate, %calc, %analysis, %record, %import, %run-query, %render, %viz, %render-document, %trace, %schedule, %seed, %engine, %jobs, %budget, %verbosity, %strict, %lint, %search, %views, %documents, %list, the %check-* settings and the repository commands. Discover the commands with `%help` (every command with its arguments) and the settings with the command alone (`%schedule`, `%engine`). A command that reports an error fails the call with its output.

line.description: one meta command line as typed at the sysml prompt, starting with %, e.g. %list, %help, %instantiate Demo::car, %features car all

session.description: session name; omit for the default session

name: repl_command

quit.description: the line was %quit, which ends a terminal and is only noted here
